description:
Cast Prized Statue by paying {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prized Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prized Statue.
When Prized Statue leaves the battlefield, it and Scrap Trawler trigger.
Resolve the Prized Statue trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Prized Statue from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
